Groton Township Zoning Resolution Resolution #2022-47 108 PURPOSE ACCESSORY SOLAR ENERGY SYSTEMS It is the purpose of this regulation to promote the safe, effective and efficient use of accessory solar energy systems installed to reduce the on-site consumption of utility supplied electricity.
